forum.title: DMA Setup not Generated on STM32N6
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @therealergo

Thank you for your contribution.

Sometimes the IOC file can become corrupted. Since you fully deleted and re-created the project and everything then worked as expected, this behavior does not appear to be a CubeMX bug in this case.

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
With HPDMA configured for SAI1A, no DMA setup code is generated with CubeMX 6.17.0. See attached IOC file as an example. Possible that I'm missing a required setting, but I can't find anything.

Edit: Fully deleting and re-creating project seems to have fixed it :shrug:.
